label: banned three major media outlets (CNN, Politico, MS Now) from White House grounds and confiscated press credentials
detail: President Trump denied White House access to journalists from CNN, Politico, and MS Now on Saturday morning, confiscating their press credentials. Trump announced the ban via Truth Social on Friday, stating he was banning the organizations because of their 'constant reporting of fake news,' and later said 'I don't have to let them into the people's house.'
source_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

label: conducted drone attack on Moscow region killing at least two people
detail: Ukraine launched a large-scale drone attack on Moscow and the Moscow region, killing at least two people and damaging a major oil refinery. President Zelenskyy praised the strikes, stating they targeted key Russian oil industry and logistics facilities. Russian authorities reported intercepting over 1,600 drones, with 450 heading for the capital.
source_title: Two killed in Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow, says Russia

label: pushed back on US warnings over rapid AI development, rejecting calls for slowdown as bid to lock in US advantage
detail: China's foreign ministry responded to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for 'worldwide pacing of the frontier' AI development by saying 'fearmongering, confrontation and vicious competition will only disrupt the process of global AI governance.' Analysts noted China views such slowdown calls as an attempt to lock in US technological advantage and will not jeopardize progress in closing the gap with US frontier models, as AI is considered a 'core sovereignty capability.'
source_title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development

label: targeted Moscow with hundreds of drones on final day of Russian parliamentary election
detail: Ukraine conducted a large-scale drone attack on Moscow and the surrounding region, involving hundreds of drones. The attack killed at least three people and damaged a Moscow oil refinery. Ukraine's President Zelenskyy confirmed the use of domestically produced Flamingo cruise missiles and other weapons in the strike.
source_title: Hundreds of drones target Moscow on last day of voting in Russia’s parliamentary election

label: warns that Trump's war with Iran will complicate next month's budget
detail: UK minister Bridget Phillipson stated that next month's budget will be made more difficult by Donald Trump's military campaign against Iran, which has disrupted global oil supplies and caused inflationary pressures that will affect the chancellor's budget planning.
source_title: UK minister warns of impact of Trump’s Iran war on next month’s budget

label: called for Europe to take a more sensible view of Trump's administration and said he wants to bring Trump's ICE adviser to the UK to help secure borders
detail: Nigel Farage, Reform UK leader, speaking at a US event, said he wants to 'hijack' Tom Homan, Trump's ICE adviser, and bring him to the UK to help secure UK borders. Farage also called for Europe to take a 'more sensible view' of the Trump administration rather than seeing it as 'villainous'.
source_title: Farage says he wants to ‘hijack’ Trump’s ICE czar to help secure UK border

label: reached a security deal on Greenland
detail: The US and Denmark announced a deal on Greenland's security, resolving a diplomatic dispute. Denmark maintains sovereignty while the US develops a significant military presence on the island and bans adversaries from building bases there.
source_title: US and Denmark reach Greenland security deal
